title: Rotational spectroscopy of mono-deuterated oxirane (c-C<SUB>2</SUB>H<SUB>3</SUB>DO) and its detection towards IRAS 16293-2422 B
question: Improve the laboratory rotational spectroscopic parameters of mono-deuterated oxirane ($c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO) and use the updated rest frequencies to detect it and determine its abundance and deuteration ratio towards IRAS 16293$-$2422 B.

what.value: Microwave transition frequencies of c-C2H3DO (18 transitions kept)

evidence.quote: We refitted the previous $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO data (cite: c-C2H4O_div-isos_rot_1974; c-C2H3DO_rot_2019) in order to derive transition frequencies, their uncertainties and intensities for our present laboratory studies.

what.value: Millimetre wave (112 transitions) and far-infrared (782 transitions / 392 frequencies) laboratory data of c-C2H3DO

evidence.quote: We employed the millimetre wave data from (cite: c-C2H3DO_rot_2019) as provided by one of the authors of that study

what.value: Scaled quantum-chemical spectroscopic parameters up to sixth order for c-C2H3DO

evidence.quote: We employed the scaled spectroscopic parameters up to sixth order from a quantum-chemical calculation (cite: c-C2H2DO_calc_param_2014) as starting values as was done by (cite: c-C2H3DO_rot_2019).

what.value: Column density and rotational temperature (125 K) of main isotopologue c-C2H4O towards IRAS 16293-2422 B

evidence.quote: We assumed $T_{\rm rot} = 125$ K in our initial calculations as was determined for $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O (cite: PILS_COMs_2017).
This results in a $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO to $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O ratio of $\sim$0.15 with the $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O column density taken from (cite: PILS_COMs_2017).

recipe.goal: Fit laboratory rotational transitions and calculate rest frequencies and spectroscopic parameters of c-C2H3DO
recipe.method: Global least-squares fitting of new submillimetre laboratory transitions (490-750 GHz and 810-1060 GHz) combined with previous MW, mmW, and recalibrated FIR data using Watson's S reduction (III^l representation) and A reduction (I^r representation).
key_parameters: 1504 new sub-mmW transitions (1091 frequencies) in 490-750 GHz and 810-1060 GHz; global fit of 2416 transitions (1613 frequencies) with J_max = 58, K_a,max = 43, K_c,max = 56
assumptions: Dipole moment components derived from structure: mu_a = 0.36 D, mu_b = 1.86 D, mu_c = 0.08 D
Assigned uncertainties: 50 kHz for MW data, 5 kHz for mmW data, 0.00008 cm^-1 for FIR data, and 5 to 50 kHz for new sub-mmW lines

recipe.goal: Fit LTE synthetic spectra to ALMA PILS Band 7 and Band 6 data to identify c-C2H3DO and derive column density and D/H ratio
recipe.method: Calculate LTE synthetic spectra using updated c-C2H3DO rest frequencies (from S reduction, III^l representation) and fit to ALMA PILS Band 7 and Band 6 spectra at the offset position of IRAS 16293-2422 B.
key_parameters: T_rot = 125 K, FWHM linewidth = 1 km s^-1, LSR velocity offset = 2.6 km s^-1
assumptions: Local thermodynamical equilibrium (LTE) and 4 equivalent H atoms in c-C2H4O for D-to-H conversion

recipe.goal: Construct rotation diagram to independently derive rotational temperature and column density
recipe.method: Fit a rotation diagram to the unblended or slightly blended c-C2H3DO transitions spanning a range of upper state energies (33 to 122 K).
assumptions: LTE optically thin lines (standard rotation diagram assumption)

answer_key.quantity: Rotational constant A of c-C2H3DO (S reduction, III^l)
Rotational constant B of c-C2H3DO (S reduction, III^l)
Rotational constant C of c-C2H3DO (S reduction, III^l)
Dipole moment component mu_a of c-C2H3DO

evidence.quote: We derived from the structural parameters of the molecule that the rotation of the principal inertial axis system of $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO with respect to that of $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O leads to a small $\mu _a$ dipole moment component of 0.36 D, a very small $\mu _c = 0.08$ D and an almost unchanged $\mu _b = 1.86$ D.

answer_key.quantity: Dipole moment component mu_b of c-C2H3DO

evidence.quote: We derived from the structural parameters of the molecule that the rotation of the principal inertial axis system of $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO with respect to that of $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O leads to a small $\mu _a$ dipole moment component of 0.36 D, a very small $\mu _c = 0.08$ D and an almost unchanged $\mu _b = 1.86$ D.

answer_key.quantity: Dipole moment component mu_c of c-C2H3DO

evidence.quote: We derived from the structural parameters of the molecule that the rotation of the principal inertial axis system of $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO with respect to that of $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O leads to a small $\mu _a$ dipole moment component of 0.36 D, a very small $\mu _c = 0.08$ D and an almost unchanged $\mu _b = 1.86$ D.

answer_key.quantity: c-C2H3DO column density (from LTE synthetic spectrum modelling at 125 K)

evidence.quote: The analysis yielded a $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO column density $8.9 \times 10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$.
This results in a $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO to $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O ratio of $\sim$0.15 with the $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O column density taken from (cite: PILS_COMs_2017).

answer_key.quantity: D-to-H ratio per H atom for oxirane

evidence.quote: This corresponds to a D-to-H ratio of $\sim$0.036 per H atom because all four H atoms in $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O are equivalent with respect to substitution by one D.

answer_key.quantity: Rotational temperature T_rot of c-C2H3DO (from rotation diagram)

evidence.quote: Fits of the detected lines using the rotation diagrams yield a temperature of $T_{\rm rot} = 103 \pm 19$ K, which in turn agrees well with 125 K derived for the $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O main isotopologue previously.
The temperature of $103 \pm 19$ K determined from the rotation diagram $c$-C$_2$H$_3$DO agrees well with the 125 K obtained for $c$-C$_2$H$_4$O (cite: PILS_COMs_2017).

The column density from the rotation diagram of $(7.8 \pm 1.5) \times 10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$ is slightly lower than $8.9 \times 10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$ derived from the modelling applying 125 K to some degree because the partition function value is lower at 103 K than at 125 K.

not_stated_but_needed: Exact celestial coordinates of the offset extraction position towards IRAS 16293-2422 B
Software or code used to compute the LTE synthetic spectra and fit the ALMA PILS spectra
Assumed source size (beam filling factor) and background continuum temperature used in the LTE radiative transfer modelling
Exact numeric value of the c-C2H4O column density taken from (cite: PILS_COMs_2017) to compute the 0.15 ratio
ALMA calibration and imaging parameters (inherited from Jørgensen et al. 2016 and Taquet et al. 2018)
missing_for_reproduction: Exact RA/Dec coordinates of the IRAS 16293-2422 B offset position spectrum (requires consulting Jørgensen et al. 2016)
Source size and background continuum temperature assumed in the LTE radiative transfer calculation
Integrated line intensities (W or int T dV) of the individual unblended ALMA transitions used to construct the rotation diagram in Fig. 6
score_reason: The laboratory spectroscopy, line lists, SPFIT/SPCAT parameter files, CDMS predictions, and ALMA data are all publicly available, and the LTE/rotation diagram parameters (T_rot, FWHM, v_LSR) are clearly stated; however, the exact extraction coordinates, LTE source size/continuum treatment, and individual integrated line fluxes for the rotation diagram are not tabulated in the paper.
rediscovery_reason: Both the ALMA data (projects 2013.1.00278.S and 2016.1.01150.S) and the CDMS spectroscopic catalog entry for c-C2H3DO are public, and the main astronomical results (T_rot = 103 +/- 19 K, N = 8.9e14 and 7.8e14 cm^-2, D/H = 0.036) are clear numeric targets derivable from standard LTE/rotation diagram analysis.
